headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 25, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up with several teams experiencing ups and downs. Here's a look at the top news, injuries, and roster movements from May 25, 2026.

The Chicago Cubs fell short in Pittsburgh, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Pirates. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. The Tampa Bay Rays also suffered a loss, falling to the Orioles in a thrilling 7-9 showdown. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Shane McClanahan pitched 5.1 strong innings.

Several teams have been impacted by injuries, with the Colorado Rockies placing left-handed pitcher Jose Quintana on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow sprain. The Washington Nationals also made a roster move, transferring right-handed pitcher Max Kranick from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list for right elbow surgery recovery.

There were several trades and roster movements on May 25, 2026. The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash. The Rockies also acquired right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker from the Philadelphia Phillies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley to the Miami Marlins for right fielder Rece Hinds. The Tampa Bay Rays traded left-handed pitcher Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for third baseman Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 1-2 decision to the Pittsburgh Pirates, failing to secure a win. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Ben Brown pitched 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Shane McClanahan pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Rays.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 1-3 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Romo leading the Twins' offense. Romo hit a home run, his fifth of the season, to drive in two runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies' Jose Quintana Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left-handed pitcher Jose Quintana has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow sprain. The injury occurred on May 25, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash on May 25, 2026.
